sourceText:
Awesome Healthy Chocolate Pizza Cookie
By: Adam Paul Green
Published: Monday, May 7, 2012 - 4:23pm

Ingredients




1 1/2 cups flour
1/2 tsp baking soda
1/2 tsp salt
3/4 cup softened butter
1/2 cup brown sugar (firmly packed)
1 egg
1/2 tsp vanilla
3/4 cup Xocai Sipping Xocolate, divided
1/2 cup peanut butter

Preparation

1 Preheat oven to 350 degrees. In small bowl, combine flour, baking soda, and salt and then set aside. In a large bowl, beat butter and brown sugar until creamy. Beat in egg and vanilla. Gradually add flour mixture ans stir in 1/4 cup Sipping Xocolate. Spread batter into two pie pans; bake for 20 minutes. Remove from oven and immediately sprinkle 1/4 cup Sipping Xocolate on each pizza cookie. Drop peanut butter by spoonfuls on top; let stand to melt and spread out over top. Serves12

About

Awesome Healthy Chocolate Pizza Cookie made with Xocai Healthy Sipping Xocolate!
